title: Federal Research-to-Implementation Evidence, 2025-2026
summary: Eight bounded official records that move the Phase 55K research agenda toward named obligations, awards, contracts, facilities, a scheduled field trial, a delivered production milestone, transmission financing, and test or standards artifacts.
scope: The collection tests whether high-level federal research and policy direction has crossed a verifiable implementation threshold. Each record is assigned the strongest stage the source supports, while the next physical, technical, regulatory, or operating gate remains explicit.
download_note: The bundle contains five official local captures, three official-link records for hosts that blocked automated export, consolidated FTFN summaries, a README, and a machine-readable manifest with SHA-256 checksums.
method_note: Implementation is staged as direction, selection, award or obligation, physical milestone, test, acceptance, operation, and scaled outcome. A record advances only to the highest stage directly supported by its official evidence.
